skills.description: Work with apps hosted on AppHaven. Use when the user asks about an AppHaven deployment (is it deployed/running, on what URL), build failures or logs, container/runtime logs, crashes, app configuration/variables, or when writing or editing apphaven.yaml. Also use to set up AppHaven access (install the apphaven CLI, log in).
